scenario.title: Late shipments
scenario.initial_request: Build a chatbot that tells customers why their parcel is late

F-01.statement: Pickup log shows median delay of 2.0 hours and 60 pickups.

F-02.statement: At handover stage, 300 out of 1000 orders are late (30% lateness).

F-03.statement: Release batch job RELEASE-BATCH had 21 failed runs out of 30 runs, with 290 orders released after pickup.

CL-01.statement: Build a chatbot that tells customers why their parcel is late

CL-02.statement: The carrier picks up two hours late, that's why parcels are late.

H-REQ-FRAMING.statement: The request assumes that customers need explanations for late shipments, implying the root cause is lack of communication.

H-CARRIER-DELAY.statement: Late shipments are primarily caused by carrier delays after pickup.

H-WAREHOUSE-DELAY.statement: Late shipments are primarily caused by delays in warehouse processing before pickup.

H-PICKUP-SCHEDULE-ISSUE.statement: Late shipments are primarily caused by missed or delayed pickup schedule execution.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The pickup log shows a median pickup delay of 2 hours across 60 pickups, indicating that pickup schedule execution delays are present and could contribute to late shipments.
Observation indicates 30% of orders are late at the handover stage.

E-03.content: The carrier picks up two hours late, that's why parcels are late.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The stakeholder attributes late parcels to carrier pickup being two hours late, suggesting carrier delay after pickup as a cause of late shipments.

The release batch job RELEASE-BATCH failed in 21 of 30 runs, and 290 orders were released after pickup, indicating warehouse release process issues that can delay order fulfillment and contribute to late shipments.

E-05.content: Carrier contract §3: pickup schedule changes run after SH-CAR confirms.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The carrier contract states that pickup schedule changes only take effect after the carrier (SH-CAR) confirms them, indicating that schedule adjustments depend on carrier approval.
